Those seeking assistance can contact +977 985 131 6807 or +977 970 910 7500, the MEA said. Of the 291 foreign nationals reported missing, others include citizens of Australia, the Netherlands, the United States, Malaysia, the United Kingdom and South Africa.

The 2027 elections will test alliances and demands for representation and livelihoods.

title: In 1984, NASA sent 3,301 bees to space to see how they built honeycomb
content: In 1984, NASA's Space Shuttle Discovery took thousands of honeybees into space, marking a unique experiment in microgravity. These resilient insects adapted quickly to their extraterrestrial surroundings, building about 200 centimeters of honeycomb in just seven days. Researchers studied the differences in the bees' construction, noting significant variations in cell size and wall thickness between their cosmic creations and those made on Earth.

title: ‘I’m retired bro’: Gukesh’s cheeky reply to troll gets unexpected twist
content: World champion D Gukesh shared a funny exchange with an online troll who initially told him to retire. After Gukesh jokingly replied, “Sorry I’m retired bro” when asked for a chess match, the user revealed it was a dare from friends. Gukesh posted the exchange with “Haters are fun bro” amid scrutiny over his recent form.

title: Anthropic tells SF staff to WFH over security guard strike threat that union denies
content: Anthropic asked employees at its San Francisco offices to work from home on Monday and Tuesday after security contractor Allied Universal warned of a possible strike by its guards. The SEIU, which represents those workers, says it has called no strike authorisation vote and issued no strike threat this week. The union has been negotiating with California security firms over wages and healthcare since April.

title: UK couple face demolition order for home built for disabled daughter over planning row
content: A Wiltshire couple who built a four-bedroom home for their disabled daughter in 2022 now face a council demolition order following a planning dispute. The property, built on Green Belt land, includes a basement and decking that were not part of the approved plans. The couple have appealed to the Planning Inspectorate, with a decision expected in autumn.

Concerned by recent AI-related security incidents, Gates suggests that if the U.S. takes the lead, China may follow in restricting hazardous AI models. He pushes for a global regulatory framework akin to those in nuclear and aviation sectors.

title: Detained by ICE, US Green Card holder from Andhra Pradesh gets bail

She emphasized that dreams are driven by focused efforts and a clear vision for the future, unlike wishes, which tend to lack the necessary determination for realization. content: CIA director is believed to have delivered a warning to Russian officials against escalating the conflict . the message was reportedly a "just don’t do it" warning . tensions between Moscow and the UK have also risen over Britain's military support for Ukraine .

title: In 2002, a Nasa intern stole Moon rocks for love then his online deal became a trap
content: the stolen collection included about 17 pounds of moon rocks, material from a martian meteorite and research notes belonging to Nasa scientist Everett Gibson . investigators posed as buyers and arranged a meeting in Orlando on the anniversary of the Apollo 11 moon landing . by then, they were already closing in on those who had taken the samples .
